examples.job_description:
Applied AI Engineer
Remote; candidates must be located full time in the United States. Reports to the VP of Product and Engineering.

About the company
A fully remote fintech and proptech company that helps homeowners access home equity without traditional monthly payments.

What you will do
- Share AI capabilities across the organization, keep a prioritized backlog of AI opportunities and frame initiatives from problem to success criteria.
- Build AI features and workflows with LLM APIs, RAG pipelines and agentic frameworks, and create automations with low-code tools such as n8n or Make.
- Work with product, operations and business teams to find AI-driven improvements, and document implementations for the wider team.

Requirements
- 6+ years in software engineering.
- At least 2 years building production AI or LLM-powered applications.
- Hands-on experience with LLM APIs and prompt engineering.
- Hands-on experience with RAG.
- Hands-on experience with agentic workflow design.
- Proficiency with low-code or no-code tools such as n8n, Make or Zapier.
- Experience with AI-assisted development tools and strong engineering fundamentals.
- Fluency in Python or TypeScript/Node.js.
- Familiarity with PostgreSQL.
- Experience with AWS, Vercel or similar platforms.
- Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex or similar multi-agent frameworks.
- Familiarity with vector databases, embedding pipelines and LLM evaluation frameworks.
- Self-directed, able to operate as a team of one and to communicate with non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred
- Experience in fintech, proptech or real estate technology, especially with sensitive financial data or consumer lending.
- Knowledge of SOC 2 or data privacy frameworks.

Compensation: USD 135,000 to 175,000 per year.

examples.job_description:
Senior Cloud Platform Engineer, Terraform and Kubernetes
Fort Worth, Texas. Candidates in the Central or Eastern US time zones are preferred.

About the company
A commerce media technology company whose software helps digital marketplaces monetize first-party audiences. The platform engineering team runs the infrastructure for a high-scale SaaS advertising platform and is moving workloads to Kubernetes and standardizing on Terraform.

What you will do
- Lead the design and buildout of Kubernetes infrastructure on AWS (EKS): cluster architecture, networking, observability and developer workflows.
- Own Terraform codebases: module standards, best practices and infrastructure-as-code adoption across teams.
- Plan and deliver infrastructure modernization with engineering leads.
- Improve CI/CD pipelines for deployment safety, speed and auditability (GitHub Actions).
- Take part in on-call and incident response, driving root-cause analysis.

Required qualifications
- 5+ years in cloud infrastructure or platform engineering.
- Deep hands-on Terraform experience, including modules, large-scale state management and code structure.
- Production Kubernetes experience (EKS preferred): cluster operations, Helm, networking, RBAC and troubleshooting live workloads.
- Strong AWS foundation: VPC, IAM, ECS, EC2, S3 and Route 53.
- CI/CD design and implementation (GitHub Actions preferred).
- Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Datadog, CloudWatch, PagerDuty).
- Excellent written communication: status updates, design proposals and post-mortems.

Nice to have
- CloudFormation experience.
- Leading cloud migrations or modernization projects.
- GitOps workflows (ArgoCD, Flux).
- HashiCorp certification (Terraform Associate or higher).
- Building internal platforms or developer tooling.
